items.title: Arnold Loyacano Interview, 1956-09-29
items.q: Boucher has one of the most beautiful, I think it's the most beautiful cafe in the world

ctx.x: What other, uh, businesses have you been in other than the musician business?

Well, that's all except for a year and a half I worked for the government. But, uh, I never cared for anything else but music. I preferred to play music because it was easy, because the remuneration was big, and, uh, it was a clean job. And except for a few cafes where I had to inhale all that smoke and stink every night, my jobs were mostly in dance halls or in, uh, theaters. Because I picked them that way. I didn't try to jump the gun. I waited until the job was open and then I applied for it or they asked me.…
With a band or? No, not with no band.
